reviewedLabels.classification: Astra-reviewed machine annotations; not human gold

method.grain: non-whitespace UTF-16 code units inside source-bound label spans
method.alignment: caseId + sourceKind + exact UTF-16 range; registry and label text hashes verified against unchanged original source
method.characterWeightedAgreement: matching prediction/gold characters divided by all labeled non-whitespace characters; unreviewed is disagreement
method.prEqualWeightedAgreement: arithmetic mean of the four per-PR character agreement rates
method.commonSelected: intersection of registry units selected by every V0-V4 version; conditional denominator includes only labeled characters in those units
method.consistentSingleRoleOracle: for each selected unit, credit the largest intersecting gold-class character count; one predicted role per unit; unselected and policy-excluded units receive zero; source characters outside gold spans are excluded
method.sensitivity: original frozen-label scores remain primary; reviewed-label recomputation is a separate post-hoc sensitivity analysis

limitations: Neither label version is human-verified gold.
This audit performs no semantic relabeling and makes no version-superiority or causal claim.
The oracle is only a simple upper bound for one role per existing unit under the stated coverage rules; it is not an achievable model score or a bound for different segmentation.
Only the four fixed public PRs and the completed single live run are measured.
